Initial release of dlazy-vidu-audio-clone.

- Enables one-click voice cloning and text-to-speech audio generation using Vidu Audio Clone.
- Provides command-line options for audio source, prompt, input JSON, and async task handling.
- Includes error codes and detailed agent instructions for common issues like missing API keys or insufficient balance.
- Output format returns downloadable URLs for generated audio results.
- Installation via npm: npm install -g @dlazy/cli@1.0.5.
